segments.sn48.20:1.3: Saddhindriyaṃ … pe … paññindriyaṃ – imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañcindriyāni.
segments.sn48.20:1.5: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.
segments.sn48.20:2.1: Paṭilābho tayo saṃkhittā, vitthārā apare tayo;
segments.sn48.20:2.3: Paṭipanno ca sampanno [paṭipanno cūpasamo (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)], dasamaṃ āsavakkhayanti.
